name: Choutsugai Shirou
source: Main character of the second route. Hates both heroes and monsters after a monster killed his family. An elite cameraman who graduated from the Faculty of Law of the Imperial University. Loves gossip and money. Only loves "Bell-chan" who he met when he was young.
